semanticChecks: Four cerebral lobes and principal planning/thinking/motor/emotion/motivation/sensory-spatial/auditory-language-memory/visual roles retained; diagram smell/emotion/will/taste/understanding/judgment associations never exclusive one-to-one processing or diagnostic map.

Cognition includes learning/recall/language/recognition/action/planning-sequencing; one difficulty never means global loss. Face recognition and sequencing distinguish retained ability/support stage; no site diagnosis.

Dementia daily/social impairment and multiple causes retained; one forgetfulness episode not diagnosis, new difficulty not dismissed by age. Specialist assessment/individual plan/facility guidance remain explicit.

Aging versus dementia forgetting compares partial/whole event/course/awareness/life impact as cues, not universal table. Awareness and worry do not exclude or prove dementia; progression differs by cause/state, no fixed pace.

Life history/routine/remaining ability/motivation, concise clear words and time to answer retained; no staff-convenience rearrangement. Activity/day rhythm respects preference/state, no forced identical activity.

Accepting emotion differs from confirming unverified events. No argument to force admission or public memory tests causing shame. Resident words retained, facts checked together as needed and passed to responsible person.

Alzheimer atrophy/new-event memory/gradual change, vascular damage/site-related differences/possible stepwise change/hemiparesis/aphasia retained. Lewy visual hallucinations/cognitive-attention-response fluctuation/slowness/rigidity and dream-enactment REM disorder possibilities remain not universal or single-feature diagnosis.

Ordinary REM knowledge differs from observed dream-related vocal/limb actions; actions/time recorded and explicit medical-staff consultation preserved. Alpha-synuclein abnormal accumulation is not occipital-only atrophy; cognitive/motor/sleep professional assessment retained.

Frontotemporal atrophy-related behavior/personality/language/repetition varies by individual. No cheerful-Alzheimer/aggressive-frontotemporal stereotype, no atrophy-only cause/function conclusion. Some Alzheimer medicine aims to slow progression, no universal effect promise; explicit physician drug decision retained.

Core memory/orientation/executive/understanding/judgment difficulties tied to actual daily functions, not equal severity in all. BPSD anxiety/irritability/hallucination/delusion/restlessness/repeated walking reflects physical/environmental/relational/emotional factors, peripheral label never lower importance.

Fear/pain/unexpressed urinary-bowel needs may underlie strong words/hitting. Actual behavior/before-after context assessed without personality assumption. Walking may have purpose; searching/toilet examples are observation prompts, not preassigned explanations.

Core/BPSD grouping organizes view, not priority; physical changes shared with team, no worker-driven drug increase or restraint. Known/unconfirmed separated for responsible person; urgent abnormality interrupts routine questioning for help.

Kidney urine production→ureter→temporary bladder storage→urethra exit, renal pelvis collection/connection and cerebral/brainstem/spinal regulation retained. Urge/place understanding/mobility are separate abilities.

Approximate bladder500mL and urge200–300mL are teaching reference, never individual guarantee, toilet denial/holding criterion or disease diagnosis. Male generally longer urethra/prostate surrounding portion does not determine mobility/help preference. Urge respected under individual plan and changes reported.

All numerical values, units and time scopes retained: daily1,000–1,500mL reference;2,000–3,000mL or more high example;300–500mL or less low example;daily4–6times;daytime8+ andnight2+ cautions. Polyuria/oliguria names and values do not diagnose everyone.

Abnormal change/distress never waits for complete record before necessary contact; individual observation/report plan, no independent water/drug changes from generic numbers.

Before diaper exchange: condition check/purpose/action explanation/consent/privacy/equipment/appropriate bed height/waterproof sheet before start, no prolonged exposure. Side/supine/hip lift only fits ability/state/plan/permission, never forced.
Source example sequence retains side positioning/sheet→supine→permitted capable hip lift and trousers down→tape opening, as conditional teaching example. Pain/difficulty means method confirmation.

Wash-water temperature appropriate, shower-bottle example subordinate to facility individual method; folds/no rubbing/gentle drying and female urethral→anal direction retained with no dirty return and clean surface/material each wipe.

Dirty side wrapped inward, clean/used separation, no contamination via diaper/gloves. Dirty-to-clean transition includes glove removal/hand hygiene/new gloves if needed per procedure. Return-to-supine/dirty diaper removal combination follows confirmed individual positioning and clean layout.

Simplified overlapping diaper illustration never contamination permission; actual trained clean/dirty boundary method retained.2–3finger abdomen/thigh example avoids overtightness, not universal product measurement; actual type/size/instructions/skin/resident sensation checked.

No leak does not mean complete if rolled edge/wrinkle/tight pain. Pressure injury possibility, product position/wrinkles/skin/sensation/clothes/sheet/itch and explicit responsible-person reporting retained; no independent alternate-cause conclusion.

Clothing return only capable/permitted participation; no difficult demands; final condition/comfort/bed/environment safety/cleanup/hand hygiene/ventilation without chilling retained. Text never guarantees practical skill; plan/procedure/training remain required.
